steps.name: Nobleman of the slums (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Lashur] in “Glaston Central Square,” obtain the <Mysterious Fragment> and report the quest to [Lashur] in “Glaston Central Square.”

lines.text: (In front of the Siren Fountain, a famous attraction in Glaston Central Square. Not only local residents, but also people who seem to be from other areas are looking at the fountain.)
(One person throws a coin into the fountain and makes a wish, and the other person who sees it follows suit as if possessed by something.)
Please help me meet a good person this year... .
I hope your mother is healthy... .
Please let Ellie earn a lot… .
(Coins filled with people's precious hearts sparkle beautifully under the sunlight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's pretty. I guess I should make a wish too.
(At that time, a man wearing sparkling jewelry as if he had swallowed gold appears in front of the Siren Fountain.)
(Then the people who were making the wish step back as if they were used to it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eh?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: You guys came to make a wish, right? I'll pay for the siren, so just make a wish. Don't spend money for nothing. Okay? ha ha ha.
(Rashur takes out gold coins from his gold coin bag and throws them one by one towards the fountain, as if he were feeding the birds in the square.)
(Every time, people make a wish and say thank you to Rashur.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Mr. Rashur. It’s been a while since I saw you at Liftrasir.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Oh, it's you. Now, make a wish here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What do you wish for...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm….)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Can't seem to choose what wish to make? Then pray for all your worries.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: If one gold coin is one wish, how many gold coins do you need for your wish?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I don't know.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Is this enough?
(Lashur lifts the bag of gold coins upside down and pours them all into the fountain.)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I don't know what your situation is, and I don't care, but everything will be fine. I, Rashur, am praying for you like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your concern, but aren't you using it too much?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hahaha, what about money? It's always there and there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something that exists even if it is not there, something that is not there even if it is there... , isn't it?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Well, I've never been there before. ha ha ha. Anyway, don't underestimate you. You are a great person.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: The center of gossip in Glaston.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: There have been rumors for some time that a hero from another continent will visit the slums of Rashuet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Rashuet a slum? I came to Glaston today... . No, I'm sure there aren't many people who know that I'm coming to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: The rumors of Glaston are like smoke. If it doesn't exist, create it and spread it around. It permeates people like that... .

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: A lot of information is secretly gathered in Richberry, and there is some of it that you might like. how is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: If you share with me what you have, maybe I can let you know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you need?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I heard that rare mysterious fragments are found in places where strong people like you go. Not a lot, just give me 20.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Just keep it as a collection and won't use it anywhere else, so don't worry too much. ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…we need information first, so let’s pass it on….)

steps.name: Nobleman of the Slums (2)
steps.objective: After talking to [Lasur] at “Glaston Central Square”, report the quest to [Manuel] at “Slum Lasuette Entrance”.

lines.text: (Lashur looks at the fragments he received from %s and smiles slightly.)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: This is a fragment of that rumor. It's rare, but I don't think I can do anything with it. It should have meaning as a collection.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What collection is it?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Collect rare stones and such. I'm tired of collecting gold nuggets.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: You look fed up with me too. ha ha ha. Then, as promised, I will give you good information.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: The head of the Diamont family, a family credited with founding the country, went to Rashuet today as well. Is this enough?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: You look like you have no idea? I guess it's a big deal to you that a nobleman went to the slums.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Couldn’t you just go?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Nobles related to parliament usually do not do anything related to the lower classes. It is extremely rare for something to appear in a slum.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Well, sometimes the royal family or His Majesty visits.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: If such a noble person visited a slum, it would mean that something happened, whether it was bad or good.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Do you understand now? That's why I said it was good information. ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Mr. Lashur.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Personally, I'm a little curious, but I don't want to get too involved. There's something good about being associated with a nobleman.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: I think it will be helpful to you who have more connections here and there than me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What… .

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hahaha. I'll leave it to you to decide what to do with this information.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: As I said before, I compensated you sufficiently and I will see you later. friend.
(Lashur taps %s on the shoulder and disappears somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What a unique person... . First of all, I have to go to Lashuette Street again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, by the way, I’ve heard the name Diamont before… .

steps.name: Nobleman of the slums (3)
steps.objective: After talking to [Manuel] at the “Slum Lasuette Entrance,” obtain <Detective K's Case Record>, <Paper Rose>, and <Target Paper> at the “Eugamon Theater.” Then, report the quest to [Manuel] at the “Slum Lacheet Entrance.”

lines.text: (In a quiet alley in La Chouette, known as the ghetto, a middle-aged man with an atmosphere that does not fit the street is standing and looking into the alley.)
(Everyone seems to know who he is, bows their heads in greeting and hurries past.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That’s the person Mr. Rashure was talking about….)
(At that moment, the eyes of the middle-aged man and %s meet. The man raises his hand and gestures for them to come to him.)
You sleep there. Come here.
Don't pretend not to know. He was watching me.
(The man looks at %s and opens his mouth cautiously.)
… Looking at you, I guess I know who it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know me?
Glaston is a place sensitive to rumors. It makes no sense to not know the person at the center of such rumors.
You are the hero who saved Eastland from the threat of evil... . %s… . However, he is a major figure in the council who is rarely liked.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I would like to know who you are if you know me.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: My introduction was late. My name is Manuel, head of the Diamont family.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I don't know what brought you to Glaston, but let's pass quietly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know what I'm trying to do, and you're saying that, right? First of all, I know that you don't look at me favorably... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rather, I want to know why you are here. He comes here every day to see what he is trying to do... .

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Shh. There are many ears to listen. I can’t believe I came all the way there to look into it… .

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Hmm… . If you want to hear a story from me... . Hey, do you know a gentleman?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gentleman? Ah, gentleman!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think the name of the doll I saw at the Eugamon Theater was Gentleman...)

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Bring me something you know about the Gentleman. Then I'll tell you why I'm here.

steps.name: Nobleman of the Slums (4)
steps.objective: After talking to [Manuel] at the “Slum Lasuette Entrance”, report the quest to [Lashuet] at “Glaston Central Square”.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Detective K's case record, paper roses, target... .  A group of data that was not all accepted as evidence. I won't ask where you got this.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: There once was a man who called himself Mr. Demonic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, are you telling me right away?

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I'm just answering because I showed sincerity.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: A long time ago, I had a friend who was in a similar position to me. Although he had a weak personality, he had a dream of acting and was always writing plays.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: But with his father gone, he couldn't do anything he wanted.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I think I was extremely stressed as I was forced to take on the position of head of the family. At that time, I just wanted to help as a friend.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: It may be a coincidence, but I heard that a wizard was providing counseling to nobles regarding their concerns. So I recommended him to get counseling... .

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Haha, it's my responsibility. Because he met the wizard and changed... .

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I still remember his words. If you have the right power, you can do what you want.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: At first I didn't know what he meant, but later I learned through his actions.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: That he was hurting people on the streets every night... . He became the murderer [Gentleman] who terrified Glaston... ..

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: One rainy night. He said goodbye to me and left, saying it was the last time. After he left, a group of knights chased him all the way to Rashuet... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: I don't know what happened to him or the knights. They all disappeared without a trace. It remained like a ghost story, and decades passed by.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you've been coming here recently, there must be a reason, right?

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: There was a story that a person with a similar appearance appeared in Rashuet.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Rumors tend to grow bigger if they are not true. So I came to check for myself, but I got nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn’t this something that can be left to the knights?

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Just to ease the burden on my mind... Do you want to catch a clue that will lead to a criminal who is capable of being a vicious criminal? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Is this satisfactory?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, first of all… .

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Looks like something more is needed. But, there are some things we can't talk about, so we'll end here for now.

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: And thank you for helping my son.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have I seen Manuel's son? Ah, Alexis… .

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: The man who sold the family land and ran away to Invernell is my son.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never helped Alexis... .

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: If you helped the church in Highland, you can also say that you helped your son... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can’t believe this even reached the ears of Glastonites….)

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Has your son been talking about me? I'm helping the council... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 마누엘
lines.text: Anyway, this conversation ends here. I wish you would tell other people too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This time…? I have a feeling we’ll talk more about it later…)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's go back to the square first. If there's Rashur, let's talk more...)
(As %s returns to the square, Lashur is again seen holding a bag of gold coins and scattering them in the fountain.)

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Mr. Rashur, it is good that you donate for the square and its residents!! This kind of performance is troubling!!

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Even if all the managers come out and collect it, it’s difficult!!

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hahahaha, last time I inquired, they said it was possible.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Because I had no idea it would be this much!

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Okay. Then let's think of another way.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: When will I get all this? First, I need to call everyone in the office... .

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Hahaha, cheer up.
(Lashur pats Moran on the back as she leaves and notices eyes looking at him from behind.)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: It's you. Was the information useful?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure yet.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: That sounds to me like we need more information.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Did you hit the nail on the head? ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there any other information?

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: Well.
(Lashur laughs lightly and taps %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: That's what information is. It varies depending on the time, place, and target. I don't think that's the case now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: It's good that you understand it quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lashur.

lines.speaker: 라슈르
lines.text: See you later then. Because I'm a bit busy.
(After Rashur leaves, Moran appears in front of the fountain with his co-workers.)

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: I think the gold coins Mr. Rashure scattered alone were worth about 10 billion Eli... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Even when I think about it again, Mr. Lashur is really unique.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By the way, I got some important information, so I need to organize it.)
